description.value: House of Dosas is a South Indian restaurant chain with three Lower Mainland locations; this Surrey outlet serves the full menu of crispy dosas, idlis, biryanis, and Indo-Chinese dishes that have made the brand a Vancouver-area staple for over 16 years. The kitchen explicitly caters to gluten-free, vegan, and omnivore diners, drawing on locally sourced ingredients and recipes rooted in South Indian home cooking. Dine-in seating is available alongside online pick-up and delivery ordering.
